arguments.value: Thomas M. Golden (November 1, 1947 – July 31, 2010) served as a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania, having been nominated by President George W. Bush in 2006 and confirmed by the Senate later that year. Born in Pottsville, Pennsylvania, he earned his B.A. from Pennsylvania State University in 1969 and his J.D. from Dickinson School of Law in 1972. He then practiced law in Pennsylvania for more than three decades before his judicial appointment, serving in private practice from 1972 until 2006. His service on the federal bench ended with his death in Reading, Pennsylvania.
